parity: Verify all saved Part 2a effective-key groups agree, compare 32 pilot rows, and directly compare 24 source calls spanning reverse keys, Atbash, signs, offset 3301, shifts and one-byte variants before scoring new keys.
controls: The earlier source four-generator control and all 30 extended planted generator/reduction controls passed; retain the predeclared score >= −5.5 and score > shuffled-head maximum rule.
exclusions: This bounded source replay does not test other key families, languages or adjudications. The null reference is not an adjusted best-of-search significance test.
